alt: Four coronal cutaways of the heart in sequence, with arrows tracing blood movement through one cardiac cycle: atrial filling, then blood passing from each atrium into the ventricle below it, then ejection out of the aorta and pulmonary trunk. Blue marks deoxygenated blood on the right side, red oxygenated blood on the left. The panels are not captioned with phase names. Servier Medical Art.
